question: Guru Bipin Singh is associated with ________ dance form of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __Manipuri.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Guru Bipin Singh was a director, choreographer and teacher of Manipuri dance.
 
• The Manipuri Dance also referred to as the Manipuri Raas Leela, is one of the eight major Indian classical dance forms, originating from the state of Manipur. 
 
• He received many awards other than the Sangeet Natak Award and Kalidas Samman from the Madhya Pradesh Government are major award received by him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance. Kathak is characterized by intricate footwork and precise rhythmic patterns that the dancer articulates by controlling about 100 ankle bells.
 
• Kalbelia is a sensuous folk dance performed by the women of the Kalbelia community in Rajasthan.
